content: MCP security guidance converges on: never plaintext HTTP for a token-bearing endpoint (TLS 1.2+ minimum, 1.3 preferred); bearer tokens validated server-side (signature/expiry/audience), never passed through to a downstream service; consider mTLS for service-to-service/private-network exposure as a transport-layer authentication independent of the token. Directly informs #127 (this repo's own network-transport issue), which already independently reached the same Tailscale-or-token-or-mTLS ranking.
